product_one_liner.value: Malachyte provides real-time AI personalization of product recommendations, search and merchandising for e-commerce brands, adapting to each shopper’s behavior from their first visit.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing link was found; the /pricing URL did not return a page.

eng_blog.notes: The blog links one detailed engineer-coauthored build article, hosted by Google Cloud. The CTO’s other post is a founding/product-vision essay, not a second engineering build post.

public_docs.notes: The help center advertises 148 articles across eight categories, and public product documentation is readable.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official careers page explicitly states that there are no open positions. Third-party data/backend and solutions-engineering listings do not meet the specified AI/ML title criteria.

model_provider.value: Malachyte’s proprietary Vector AI, described as a two-headed transformer model.
model_provider.notes: This identifies the disclosed in-house model; no third-party foundation-model provider is named in the reviewed documentation, technical blog or subprocessor list.

compliance_certs.notes: The company explicitly claims GDPR compliance. This is a compliance claim, not evidence of an independently issued GDPR certification; no completed SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA or PCI DSS certification was identified.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million seed round was announced August 6, 2026, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official careers page says there are no open positions; older third-party sales listings were not treated as confirmation of current hiring.

launched_6mo.notes: The native Shopify integration became generally available in June 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Alexander Khan’s profile dates the start of his VP of Sales role to March 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A sales-role description for Malachyte names “HubSpot, Apollo, or similar” for outreach and activity tracking. These are visible hiring-stack signals, not proof of exclusive or current deployment.
